about.metaDescription: Discover xMelayu, the Southeast Asian video platform celebrating Malay, Malaysian, Indonesian, Thai, and regional amateur content.
about.content:
About xMelayu

xMelayu is a Southeast Asian video discovery platform focused on Malay, Malaysian, Indonesian, Thai, and regional user-generated video content. We curate authentic amateur videos from across the region, providing a comprehensive library for adult entertainment enthusiasts worldwide.

Our platform features content from Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, and other Southeast Asian countries. Every video is carefully tagged and categorized to help you discover content that matches your interests.

xMelayu was created with the mission of providing the most authentic and diverse collection of Southeast Asian amateur content available anywhere online. We are committed to quality, variety, and user experience.

privacy.content:
Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information.

We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze site traffic. Session cookies are used to maintain your session, while analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our platform.

We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. Your browsing activity on xMelayu remains private and is not linked to your personal identity.

By using xMelayu, you consent to our use of cookies and collection of anonymous analytics data as described in this policy.

2257.metaDescription: 18 U.S.C. § 2257 Compliance Statement for xMelayu. All models are 18+ years old.
2257.content:
18 U.S.C. § 2257 Compliance Statement

All models, actors, actresses and other persons that appear in any visual depiction of actual sexually explicit conduct on this website are over the age of eighteen (18) years.

All content on xMelayu is produced in compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Records required pursuant to 18 U.S.C. § 2257 and 28 C.F.R. § 75 are maintained by the respective producers and custodians of records for each video.

xMelayu operates as a platform and does not directly produce or host content. All videos are sourced from third-party creators who are responsible for their own compliance with applicable age verification and record-keeping requirements.
